latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Image Video AI — convert image collections into shareable videos.

- Instantly turn JPG, PNG, WEBP, or GIF images (up to 200MB) into animated video clips using cloud AI rendering.
- Delivers 1080p MP4 video in 30–60 seconds; supports custom transitions, background music, and text overlays.
- Easy upload and export workflow—no prior video editing experience required.
- Automatic setup with free token generation, cloud session handling, and credits tracking.
- Real-time status updates, error handling, and support for multiple export formats.
